failures_and_recovery: An initial 2,454,161-byte synthetic-image upload encountered HTTP 503 and its background process was later terminated. Follow-up status found 1,081,344 bytes received (33 full 32 KiB chunks), despite an empty client result file. The exact original transfer was normally aborted and status rechecked as aborted with offset 0; completed images were retained.

Completed upload wall times were 127 seconds for 340,265 bytes and 151 seconds for 399,998 bytes (about 2.7 KB/s). Existing logs did not contain per-chunk timing; the cause was not isolated and no new speed test was run.
